columns.name: Gap vs All Clients pts

columns.comment: Clients without the product while at least half of all APAC clients hold it.
columns.name: Clients With Gap vs All Clients

comment: Product penetration of SMBC APAC clients vs peers, FY2024-FY2026 (FY2026 to date): for each client and core product, whether the client holds or used it in the year, and how widely its peer group (same industry subsector), its industry sector and all APAC clients hold it. Penetration % = share of the selected clients holding the product; Peer Penetration % = the peers' rate; Gap pts = peer - own (positive = under-penetrated); Clients With Gap = clients without the product while >= 50% of their peers hold it. Rates are per fiscal year (a multi-year selection returns the latest year). When the selection is a whole peer group (e.g. Japanese automotive-parts subsidiaries - every Auto Parts client is a Japanese corporate) the peer gap nets to 0: read Clients With Gap and the sector / all-client gaps. "Which products are under-penetrated" = products with Clients With Gap > 0 OR Gap vs All Clients pts > 0.05 (more than 5 points below the APAC book). Grain: one row per golden client x core product x fiscal year (gold.fact_client_product_penetration_annual).
